plan.failureSummary: The cached page.ai instructions replayed outdated positional DOM selectors that opened the Solutions dropdown menu instead of Developers, resulting in navigation to /solutions/use-cases/critical-user-flows/ and causing the assertion expect(page.url()).toEqual('https://www.checklyhq.com/docs/') to fail.
observedIndicators: Cached page.ai runSource relied on stale positional selector '#nav > nav > div:nth-of-type(1) > div:nth-of-type(1) > div:nth-of-type(2) > button' which clicked the Solutions menu button rather than Developers.
Tool history shows the agent navigated to 'https://www.checklyhq.com/solutions/use-cases/critical-user-flows/' instead of the expected documentation URL.
User test script assertions expect 'https://www.checklyhq.com/docs/', which was missed due to the cached step misdirection.

remediationSteps.summary: Clear page.ai cache and retry test automation
remediationSteps.details: Clear the deterministic page.ai cache for checkly.test.ts and re-run the test autonomously so page.ai re-evaluates the live nav DOM and clicks the correct menu items.

plan.notes: Clearing the page.ai cache allows the AI agent to re-examine the live Checkly header layout, correctly locate and click the Developers -> Documentation link, and proceed to pass the test.
